creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Statistics

description: Simulation that randomly assigns subjects to treatment and control groups and shows how chance balances visible characteristics and a hidden variable, especially with larger samples.

learningObjectives: Apply random assignment to form treatment and control groups and compare their composition (Apply)
Describe how the balance between randomly assigned groups improves as the sample size increases (Understand)
Explain why random assignment balances unknown variables as well as known ones (Understand)

keyQuestions: How similar are the two groups before the treatment begins?
What happens to the gaps as the sample size grows?
commonMisconceptions: A lopsided random split means the randomization was done incorrectly
Researchers should rearrange the groups by hand until they look balanced
assessmentOpportunities: Student reports the typical gap for at least three sample sizes and describes the trend
Student explains that the gaps center on zero, so neither group is systematically favored
Student explains why randomization handles unmeasured variables
